areas.label: Öffentliche Seiten (Org-Website, Tickets, Shop, Formulare, Mitgliederbereich)

moves: Neue Organisation for single-org people → Profil › Deine Organisationen AddLink + single-org switcher shows a small menu too
shortcuts N, /, ⌘K → '?' key opens a 'Tastenkürzel' sheet; user menu item 'Tastenkürzel'
Einstellungen sidebar → /settings (grouped index on phones); Konto → Profil

shell.summary: <AppShell> is the one layout for the App and /admin: shadcn sidebar (drawer on phones, collapsible to icons from md, state in cookie sidebar_state) + sticky top bar (h-12) + main. The App passes search=true, which adds ⌘K search, the phone tab bar, the phone menu sheet and Sprout. /admin passes no search: no ⌘K, no Sprout, no phone tab bar (phones use the sidebar drawer trigger).

parts.name: Sidebar
parts.shows: Header: org switcher (App) or 'Zur App' (admin) + 'Suchen ⌘K' row (App). Groups: (1) Start (/) and Benachrichtigungen (/notifications, unread count badge); (2) 'Module' (home.modules): every visible nav.ts area with its icon, opening its first sub-page; sub-pages expand only under the active area; (3) 'Organisation' (general.org): Dateien (org.files.view), Einstellungen (/settings/profile), Plattform (/admin, platform admins). Footer: user menu.

actions.label: <area> / <sub-page>
actions.notes: icon turns into a spinner while the page loads (useLinkStatus); clicked item is highlighted at once; closes the phone drawer

parts.phone: App: the sidebar is never opened on phones (MenuButton/MobileMenu replace it). Admin: SidebarTrigger in the top bar opens it as a drawer.
uxNotes: Files, Settings and Platform are plain links with their own SectionNav/sub-navigation (not nav.ts areas), so their sub-pages never appear in the sidebar tree while module areas do.
Nav group label 'Organisation' reuses general.org (the Settings › Allgemein card title).

parts.name: Org switcher
parts.shows: Org logo + name at the top of the sidebar. One org: static (no menu). Several orgs or platform admin (all orgs, up to 500): dropdown listing orgs (current marked 'Aktuell') + 'Neue Organisation' (→ /onboarding?new=1).
parts.phone: Shown at the top of the Menü sheet only when there is more than one org to choose.
uxNotes: Users with exactly one org have no way to create a second org from the UI (the 'Neue Organisation' item only exists in the multi-org dropdown).
Platform admins inside a foreign org see a muted banner 'Du bist in {org} als Plattform-Admin.' above every page.

parts.name: User menu
parts.shows: Sidebar footer: avatar, name, email. Dropdown: email label, Konto (→ /settings/profile), Mein Mitgliederbereich (when the user is a contact of the org with members on; opens the portal via openMyMemberArea), Sprache (Deutsch/English with check), Abmelden.
uxNotes: 'Konto' and sidebar 'Einstellungen' both open /settings/profile (two entries, one target).

parts.name: Top bar
parts.shows: Left: MenuButton (phones, only while the tab bar is hidden: bar-fallback) or SidebarTrigger (admin, phones). Then 'where am I': a record page's crumbs registered via <TopbarCrumbs> (clickable PageCrumbs) or PageTitle = area icon + area › sub-page from the nav groups (fallback: org name / 'Plattform'). Then #topbar-actions: the page header's gear (settings), actions, ⋯ menu and primary, portalled by <HeaderActions> on every device (link primaries only from md). Right: Sprout button (App).

actions.label: gear (area settings)
actions.notes: icon button with tooltip, from PageHeader settings

actions.label: ⋯ / actions / primary
actions.notes: PageHeader content; primary has data-shortcut=new; PrimaryAction adds a split button with 'more' choices

actions.label: Sprout
actions.target: toggle Sprout panel (label sr-only below sm)

parts.phone: Primary link actions are not in the top bar but the round glass + by the tab bar; gear/actions/⋯ stay in the top bar.
uxNotes: Pages without PageHeader build „where am I“ differently: Settings via <SettingsTitle> crumbs, admin pages via PageTitle from the admin sidebar groups, wiki pages via <PageCrumbs> in the page.
PageHeader drops description on area/icon pages, so intro texts passed there (Website, Automationen, Vorlagen) are silently not shown.

parts.name: Phone tab bar
parts.shows: Floating glass capsule at the bottom (md:hidden, App only): Start (→ /, highlighted on home) · Suche (opens ⌘K dialog) · Menü (opens MobileMenu). The page's primary link action sits beside it as a round glass + (data-slot=page-primary; with 'more' choices it opens a small glass menu). Capsule shrinks to icons (or only Start on home) while scrolling down.
parts.phone: Hidden (bar-hide) while a SaveBar shows, an input has focus, or the page marks data-own-tab-bar (Einlass); then the top bar shows the menu button.
uxNotes: No Benachrichtigungen tab: the unread count is only visible as a small badge on the Menü sheet tile (not on the Menü tab itself).
Pages whose primary is a form button (e.g. automation Aktivieren) or a section button (Team 'Einladen', Fields 'Neues Feld', admin 'Neue Organisation') get no round + on phones.

parts.name: Phone menu (Menü sheet)
parts.shows: Bottom ContentSheet without title row/X (grab handle, swipe, backdrop close). Level 1: org switcher (if several orgs), the same groups as the sidebar as a 3-column tile grid (icon + label, active tinted, unread count badge on Benachrichtigungen), account block: name · email, Konto, Mein Mitgliederbereich, Sprache segmented (Deutsch/English), Abmelden. Areas with >1 sub-page drill into level 2: '‹ Menü' + area title + big rows with a check on the current sub-page.

parts.name: ⌘K search
parts.shows: Centred CommandDialog (exception in app.md). Placeholder 'Kontakte, Events, Rechnungen, Seiten …', hint text when empty, 'Suche …' while loading, 'Nichts gefunden.'. Debounced (180 ms) server search; groups: Seiten (nav pages incl. Start, Benachrichtigungen, Dateien, Vorlagen, Kontakte importieren, settings sections; max 8), Kontakte, Mitgliedschaften, Events, Rechnungen, Formulare, E-Mail (campaigns + templates), Dateien, Wissen, Projekte, Aufgaben, Vermietung (objects), Produkte, Bestellungen (shop), Vorlagen (letters).
uxNotes: No record sources for courses, shifts, HR employees, guest lists, automations, cash book or payments (app.md: every module adds its source).
Settings sections are a second hard-coded copy of SETTINGS_TABS without 'Bereiche'.
Search shortcut '/' (Shortcuts) focuses the list SearchBox, ⌘K opens global search – two search shortcuts.

parts.name: Sprout panel
parts.shows: Assistant panel in the layout (App only): right column 26rem from md (sticky, full height), full screen on phones; open state in cookie 'sprout', stays open across pages. Header: chat title, Merken (star), Neuer Chat, Letzte Chats (popover list with delete per chat, visible on hover/focus), Vollbild/Verkleinern (md+), Schließen. Body: greeting with orb + idea chips, messages with tool steps, approval cards for dangerous operations ('Ausführen' / deny), retry. Input: current page as removable context chip, attached files (stored as roots files, folder 'Sprout'), Datei anhängen, Diktieren (browser speech, hidden in Firefox), model picker (from the person's AI keys), Senden / Stoppen. States: org has AI off ('KI ist für diese Organisation ausgeschaltet (Einstellungen → API).'), no key ('Sprout braucht einen API-Schlüssel …' + 'Schlüssel hinzufügen' link to Profil).
parts.phone: Covers the whole screen (fixed inset-0); Vollbild toggle hidden.
uxNotes: Deleting a chat has no confirm and the delete icon only appears on hover/focus (app.md: nothing only on hover).
Danger operations ask through Sprout's own approval card, not ConfirmHost – a second confirm pattern.
Home's SproutAsk box is a second entry point that opens the panel with a new chat.

parts.name: Toasts / Notice
parts.shows: Server actions redirect with ?ok= / ?error= (back()); <Notice> turns them into sonner toasts (errors 8 s) and strips the params from the URL. Client code calls toast() directly.
uxNotes: Pages with sheets suppress or move Notice per sheet (e.g. Integrations, Team, Fields) – the same error may show inside the sheet or as page toast depending on params.
Some actions give no feedback at all (markAllRead, Website 'Jetzt prüfen' while pending).

parts.name: ConfirmHost
parts.shows: Mounted once in AppShell. Any submit button with data-confirm="<message key>" is held back and a compact bottom ContentSheet asks: title = message (with {count} of ticked ids or data-confirm-count / -amount), optional '<key>Hint' line, buttons Abbrechen / <the button's own label> (destructive). MenuSubmit destructive confirms by default.
uxNotes: Opt-in per button: many destructive actions in this scope skip it (team member remove/leave, invite revoke, API key revoke, payment provider 'Trennen', webhook delete, field delete, location delete, files/template trash in sheets, admin org trash, role delete, superadmin grant, passkey remove).
Admin permanent deletes use an in-form checkbox instead; Sprout uses its own approval card.

parts.name: Keyboard shortcuts
parts.shows: Outside text fields/dialogs/menus: 'n' clicks [data-shortcut=new] (PageHeader primary link / PrimaryAction main button), '/' focuses [data-shortcut=search] (list SearchBox). ⌘K/Ctrl+K toggles global search (command-search.tsx). Wiki editor: ⌘S saves at once. Automation canvas: Backspace/Delete removes the selected step.
uxNotes: No visible hint for 'n' and '/' anywhere in the UI (only ⌘K is shown in the sidebar).
Primaries rendered as form buttons or section buttons don't get data-shortcut=new.

parts.name: Notifications bell / inbox entry
parts.shows: No bell icon: the inbox is the sidebar item 'Benachrichtigungen' (InboxIcon) with the unread count as a SidebarMenuBadge (counted on every App request), plus the Home card and the Menü-sheet tile badge on phones.
uxNotes: Count only refreshes on navigation (server layout), no live update; opening a notification can switch the active org.

redesign.job: On a phone the App feels like a native iOS app; desktop unchanged.
redesign.phone: Top bar: ‹ back (nearest crumb / parent nav page) · one-line title · ⋯ (PhoneMenu: form primary, gear, header actions, ActionsMenu items, Abbrechen) · Sprout. Tab bar: Start · Suche · Menü (dot while the inbox has unread items) + round primary. Suche = search sheet (field + Abbrechen, recents, results with area tiles). Menü sheet: inbox row first, then org switcher, tiles, account. Every DropdownMenu = action sheet; picker popovers (date, wiki icon/share, product image) = bottom sheets. Segments scroll sideways; body overflow-x clip; SaveBar above the keyboard (--keyboard).
redesign.desktop: Unchanged: crumbs / area › page in the top bar, gear · actions · ⋯ · primary there, ⌘K palette (now with recents and area tiles), dropdowns and popovers anchored.
moves: Top bar gear / actions / ⋯ / form primary (phones) → one ⋯ action sheet (PhoneMenu)
Top bar crumbs (phones) → ‹ back + last crumb as title
Menü tile Benachrichtigungen → first row of the Menü sheet with count; dot on the Menü tab
Active tints text-primary/bg-primary in tab bar + Menü sheet → neutral muted

sweep.note: Checked with a one-off Playwright script (Menü sheet + drill-down, search sheet empty + with a query, ⌘K, ⋯ action sheet, a sheet/dialog, ? help, collapsed sidebar, Sprout phone + desktop, offline). Fixed: S9 — a form-button header primary with an icon is the round button on phones (and stays in ⋯ since a SaveBar hides the round button); Menü sheet without the Start tile; search lists records first, pages last with their area tile, member hits 'Nr. 6'; SaveBar inside sheets stacks full width on phones; tooltips hidden on touch screens (Sprout's X kept one open after opening); ⌘B in the help; collapsed sidebar shows an unread dot; offline page has a Neu laden link (works without JS). Left: search placeholder truncates on 390 px ('Kontakte, Events, Rechnungen …'); the admin shell on phones keeps the sidebar trigger instead of the tab bar.
